name: Degen.Money
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Twitter users reported that DeFi's liquidity mining project Degen.Money exploited a double approval vulnerability to get users' Money. The first authorization gives the pledge contract, and the second authorization gives the right to transfer money, which will result in the user's funds being taken away by the attacker. YFI founder Andre Cronje says the project does have risks.
